newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chinese premier visits Brazil's space agency.
newsitem.headline: Chinese premier visits Brazil's space agency.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng, who signed an accord on further satellite cooperation with Brazil, visited the Brazilian space agency in Sao Paulo state on Sunday.

Li, who is on a four-day official visit to Brazil, and Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso presided over the signing of an accord on Friday that will allow other peaceful uses of future Chinese-Brazilian satellites.
China and Brazil have already established a $150 million joint venture to produce Earth-monitoring satellites, the first of which was scheduled to be launched next October.
The Chinese premier also met with governor of Sao Paulo state Mario Covas and members of the Chinese community in Sao Paulo on Sunday.
Li was scheduled to visit the Amazon city of Manaus on Monday and fly to Venezuela on Tuesday for the last stop of a Latin American tour that started in Chile.

In his talks with Cardoso and other government officials, trade, agricultural cooperation and technology exchange have dominated the agenda while human rights issues have only been touched on very briefly.
